# mathpdf

This is a public file drop for sharing math materials with AI. Its only purpose is: upload files, then give AI the original file URL.

## Rules

- All materials are stored under `materials/`.
- There are no required filenames, categories, metadata, templates, or subdivisions.
- Do not infer a topic or category from a filename.
- Read original files, not the rendered website.
- Markdown is usually easiest to parse. PDFs and other file types are stored unchanged; if a model cannot parse one, ask the user to attach the original file.

## Discover files

Repository tree (filter entries whose path starts with `materials/` and whose type is `blob`):
https://api.github.com/repos/patricksonggoodyear-cyber/mathpdf/git/trees/main?recursive=1

Folder contents:
https://api.github.com/repos/patricksonggoodyear-cyber/mathpdf/contents/materials?ref=main

Raw URL pattern:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/patricksonggoodyear-cyber/mathpdf/main/materials/<filename>

Website:
https://patricksonggoodyear-cyber.github.io/mathpdf/

Everything in this repository is public.
